summary: Mynd.ai filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine amendment to its equity incentive plan, increasing the share reserve by 106 million ordinary shares (one-time addition beyond evergreen increases). No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC event is described. The filing is a standard corporate governance matter, not a special situation.
